more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Ethoxyquin is a defined quinoline-derived antioxidant. In the direct-food application described by FDA, it protects the colour of paprika, ground chilli and chilli powder. This permission has a maximum concentration of 100 parts per million. The same regulation separately discusses residues from animal-feed use; those residue limits describe a different exposure route.
more_info.uses: Used to protect colour during manufacture of paprika, ground chilli and chilli powder. The US limit for that direct-food use is 100 parts per million. Animal-feed residues are addressed separately in the regulation and are not an example of adding ethoxyquin to a retail food.
